options.content: **Operating objectives, no contractual SLA.** Ratios describe observed eligible requests; they do not prove uptime or reasoning quality. Budget appears only after a complete seven-day collection window. No traffic is unknown. Grey gaps remain visible.

panels.title: Observed SLI · 7 d
panels.description: Successful HTTP responses / successful or server-error responses. Authentication, probes, telemetry, 4xx and cancellations are excluded. A 200 stream can contain an application failure: inspect AURA delivery separately.

panels.description: 1× spends the budget at its seven-day allowance rate. Fast alert: 5 m AND 1 h above 3.36×; slow: 30 m AND 6 h above 1.4×. Both windows need ≥20 events and complete telemetry. Low traffic can hide a single failure: inspect counts below.
